scope: Read-only source/AST/mathematics/interface review. No imported production code, tests, traces, actor maps, native artifacts or simulations were executed.

review_checks.reason: support_pair_certificate computes both full exact frames, their conjunction and admission before _frame_summary. log_interval uses exact floor/ceil at 2^48, including negative values; nested distance-root display bounds are expanded outward. No displayed interval is consumed by the admission comparison.

full_exact_frame_sha256 is formed from the full exact frame canonical JSON before compaction. This review checks that source relationship; it does not independently verify an actual runtime frame hash and the independent reader does not trust that producer hash as an oracle.

Default pair_checks retains the original pair_certificate. Only explicit cone-support-v2 lazily imports the new helper. ReachTracker fixes a validated rule at construction; both current and D-to-X prospective calls use the same property. No intent wire, source age, L/H/U/buffer, old-anchor or command-filter obligation changes.

motion_safety validates rule with safety_contract, initializes all three trackers consistently and records the selected v2 rule inside the configuration payload. The independent runtime ingress and custody first-line check inspect this actual journal envelope payload; episode and same-epoch supervisor declarations must match. Default declarations remain omitted.

reach_support_replay imports only fractions/functools/math, uses independent degree84/85 Taylor polynomials with absolute Lagrange remainder bounds, and separately derives rational norm enclosures. Runtime reconstructs source-bound states and both frame/left-right signs, union max and full original U/buffers. It never calls production support or consumes compact values for admission.

Both the actual allowed-motion conjunction and the narrowly authorized D command-filter conjunction pass the metadata-selected rule into independent_pair. The legacy branch remains the previous binary independent computation; v2 returns its explicit rule and sufficient-certificate semantics.

v2 source proof freezes both production support and the independent helper. Native custody requires both new sources only for the explicit rule. Reach gates keep cf46 fixed, separately verify both helper current/Git/plan pins, bind custody geometry to selected dispatch and explicitly label the geometry admission predicate change.

The runtime shared episode-set registry rejects mixed episode/benchmark rules. Cadence records metadata-selected rules even when an episode audit fails and forwards the actual rule to source_proof. Full source/wire/physical/ELF gates remain separately necessary.
